regional-offices.looks: A centred heading and intro above a row of 2 to 4 columns; each column has an image in a soft circle, a title, a short paragraph and an outline button.
regional-offices.use: A small set of parallel places, offices or options that each have a picture and a link, e.g. regional offices.
regional-offices.avoid: Without images: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid (info-cards-grid) or Icon 1x4 Col Card (card-row-compact).

fields.columns: Match the number of items: 2, 3 or 4.
